full_judgment: 12. We have perused the impugned judgment and order dated 25-2-95. It appears that the learned Court below, in fact, has not given any reasons as submitted by the learned Advocate for the defendant-petitioner. We find substance in the submission of Md Sultan Ahmed, the learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the defendant-petitioners. Further, Md Sultan Ahmed has placed reliance on a decision reported in 43 DLR (AD) 107 wherein it has been held that the application for addition of party setting up an independent title to the land disentitle them to be included as parties within the framework work of the present suit wherein the real question to be determined whether contract for sale between the parties therein was genuine and whether on the basis thereof the plaintiff are entitled to get a decree. The averments for addition of party will convert the present suit into one for determination of title which is not permissible in law. The learned Advocate has further placed reliance on a decision reported in 43 DLR 160, wherein it has been held that in a suit for specific performance of contract it is not permissible to adjudicate on the question of title of stranger to the contract who need not therefore be made a party to such a suit.
